full stack, from planning to deployment.

- **Languages:** Python, SQL, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, C++, HTML/CSS

## Projects

- **Car Dealership Database System** (PHP, MariaDB, SQL, JavaScript): A 16-table MariaDB
  relational database with a PHP/CSS web interface modeling a full car-dealership operation.
  Includes a multi-filter vehicle search and a browser-based SQL query console; reduced
  SQL-injection exposure with constrained dropdown filters.
- **Terraria AI Agent** (Python, OpenCV, mss): A modular Python agent that plays Terraria
  autonomously from on-screen pixels, pairing real-time screen capture with OpenCV computer
  vision across separate vision, control, and decision-making subsystems.
- **Text-to-Speech Web App** (HTML, CSS, JavaScript): A responsive web app, co-developed on
  a six-person team, that reads user-entered text aloud via the browser's Web Speech API,
  with selectable language and accent.

## Experience

- **Co-Founder & Web Developer, Moderni Tech (Web Design Studio)** — June 2026 to present.
  Builds responsive custom websites for small businesses, owning the full process from
  client conversation through design, build, and launch.
- **Operations Assistant, Billing Trucking Inc.** — May 2023 to April 2025. Provided IT
  support and maintained hardware/software for drivers; managed audit-ready logistics
  paperwork.
